title: State Management in Multi-Step Workflows
query: Look up the user's saved payment method and charge them $99.99 for the premium subscription

payment_method_id.description: ID of the payment method to charge

explanation: This demonstrates STATE MANAGEMENT across steps. Step 1: get_payment_method retrieves the payment method. Step 2: charge_payment_method uses the RESULT from step 1 (payment_method_id). The notation {{step1.payment_method_id}} represents using output from previous step. In production, agents manage this state automatically, but you need to understand the dependency chain. Note: We're NOT updating subscription here - user only asked to charge, not to activate.
learning_points: Multi-step workflows require passing state between function calls
Later steps depend on results from earlier steps
Use placeholder notation like {{step1.field}} to show dependencies
Order matters: must get payment method BEFORE charging it
Only do what the user asks: they didn't ask to update subscription, just charge

wrong_answers.why_wrong: Can't charge without first getting the payment_method_id. You don't know what the ID is.
Missing required parameter payment_method_id in step 2. Must use result from step 1.

hints: This requires TWO steps: get then charge
First: get_payment_method to retrieve the payment method ID
Second: charge_payment_method using the ID from step 1
Don't update subscription - user didn't ask for that
